description: Implementation of a service class for managing device registration entities, including registration, update, and deletion, with error handling for data integrity issues.

classes.name: DeviceRegistrationWritePlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing device registration management with methods for registering, updating, and deleting device registrations, including error handling.

methods.name: registerDevice
methods.description: Registers a new device for a client, handling data integrity exceptions.

methods.name: updateDeviceRegistration
methods.description: Updates an existing device registration with new client and registration ID, setting the update timestamp.

methods.name: deleteDeviceRegistration
methods.description: Deletes a device registration by ID.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles data integrity issues during registration, throwing specific exceptions for duplicate registration IDs or other issues.
